name: Chibi Visitor v4
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modelling
creation_method: Blender 5.1.2, built through the Blender MCP server (Blender Lab extension 1.0.3). The skull relief was worked with Blender sculpt brushes (sculpt_head.py, interactive only; baked to sources/head-sculpt.json); ears, nose, neck, hair, clothing and accessories are procedural Python in generate.py. No image-to-3D service, downloaded mesh, add-on asset or downloaded texture is used. The supplied character sheet is a design reference and is not embedded.

geometry.origin: between the feet on the ground

accuracy_notes: Stylised interpretation of the owner's v4.0 sheet. Head: shallow sculpted relief on the sheet-matched skull silhouette (mean 1.25 mm, p95 6.5 mm from the parametric skull), fused ears/nose/neck and a painted face texture; the facial character is mostly texture. Hair: fused cap and fringe plus 22 separate shingled back locks in a fan off the crown; more regular than the sheet. Body, hands and shoes are simplified procedural parts. Head silhouette rows (z >= 0.60 m) are within a mean of 5.8-7.0 px (about 1 cm) of the sheet, flick and tuft tips up to about 40 px. Quality gate run 001: glTF Validator 0/0/0/0, headless rebuild byte-identical, Three.js load clean, 673 repository tests pass. Known P2: dark gap at the front of each ear. Not rigged, not registered in the catalog; gallery viewer acceptance and physical-device performance are not verified. Independent visual review (run 001): REWORK, three open P1 hair-style defects (shingle look, conical temple flicks, long ahoge).
rights: Original asset; owner-project reuse is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
